tagline.zh: 从镜头目标出发，让生成、控制与后期衔接起来。
tagline.en: Connecting visual ideas, generation, control and finishing.

about.zh: 我是 P. ÆVRYX，拥有 3 年 AI 工具使用经验，聚焦 AI 视频生成与制作、ComfyUI 工作流及 LoRA 实践。从创意、剧本分镜到审片与剪辑，结合生成结果持续迭代；现有 SOLVANE《静的形状》汽车品牌概念片、《Twenty-Four Frames》98 秒 MV 完整剪辑版，以及本地开源模型音乐短片《一圈》。
about.en: I’m P. ÆVRYX. I have three years of experience using AI tools, focusing on AI video production, ComfyUI workflows and LoRA practice. I develop concepts and storyboards, review generated footage and refine the edit. Selected work includes the SOLVANE automotive spec film The Shape of Silence, Twenty-Four Frames and One Lap, a music film made with local open-weight models.

title.zh: 《一圈》· 本地开源模型音乐短片
title.en: One Lap · Local Open-Weight Music Film

description.zh: 全部图像及视频素材使用本地部署的开源模型生成，未调用付费视频生成服务。负责视觉设计、分镜和画面取舍，以构图、光线、动作与角色一致性筛选素材。现有 2 分钟版与 63 秒精剪版；当前仅展示项目静帧与制作说明。配乐使用 Suno。
description.en: All image and video assets were generated locally with open-weight models, without paid video-generation services. I directed visual design, storyboards and shot selection, judging composition, lighting, movement and character consistency. The project includes a two-minute version and a 63-second edit; this site currently shows a still and production notes only. Music was made with Suno.

description.zh: 98 秒竖屏 MV 完整剪辑版，以胶卷串起角色一天的经历，结合线稿人物与胶片质感场景。我负责创意、角色视觉设定、分镜、素材筛选与审片，与 Agent 协作完成音乐方向、模型调用、素材处理及剪辑。本站播放 v32 的约 20 秒预览，1080p 母版保留。
description.en: A 98-second complete vertical MV edit following a character’s day through a roll of film, combining line-art characters with film-textured settings. I guide the concept, character design, shot goals, footage selection and review, collaborating with agents on music direction, model use, asset processing and editing. This site plays a roughly 20-second preview from v32; the 1080p master is retained.

title.zh: 静的形状 · SOLVANE 品牌概念片
title.en: The Shape of Silence · SOLVANE Spec Film

description.zh: SOLVANE 索澜虚构汽车品牌的 30 秒概念片，以声音驱动的线条连接城市噪声、静音与贯穿式车灯，表达“让安静被看见”。我与 Agent 协作完成创意、车辆外观设定、镜头生成与筛选、声波图形、剪辑和修正，并输出横竖版等多种规格。此处为 15 秒轻量剪辑预览。
description.en: A 30-second spec film for fictional automotive brand SOLVANE. An audio-driven line connects city noise, silence and the car’s light blade to make silence visible. With agents, I developed the idea and vehicle visuals, generated and selected shots, and worked on waveform graphics, editing and revisions, with landscape and portrait deliverables. This is a lightweight 15-second cutdown preview.

title.zh: 雨停之前 · 叙事开场

description.zh: 43 秒雨夜叙事开场。我负责创意、分镜、美术参考、素材筛选与审片，并与 Agent 协作组织预演和后期流程。现有版本包含电视画面合成与音频接缝处理，声音等细节仍可改进。
description.en: A 43-second narrative opening set on a rainy night. I developed the concept, shot goals and visual references, selected footage and reviewed revisions, working with agents on previs and finishing. This excerpt includes TV-screen compositing and audio-seam treatment; sound and other details remain open to refinement.

title.zh: ComfyUI · 角色与 LoRA 测试

description.zh: 现有 LoRA 测试中的近景、全身与姿态样图。围绕角色身份、服装和局部细节比较生成结果，调整提示词与模型强度，保留参数及版本记录。角色与基础模型来自第三方，配置、检查与文档含 AI 辅助。
description.en: Existing close-up, full-body and pose samples from LoRA tests. I compare character identity, clothing and local detail, adjust prompts and model strength, and keep parameter and version records. The character and base model are third-party; configuration, checks and documentation were AI-assisted.

notes.zh: 把 .mp3 放进 media/music/，填写 src，再配一张方形封面。这里写这首歌对你的意义。
